description: This file defines a custom JSP tag class named StoreFooterlTag that generates footer content for a web store, including the store's name and operational years.

classes.name: StoreFooterlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that outputs store footer information, including the store name and business years.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates and outputs the store footer HTML content based on the store's information.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Represents the end of the tag processing, proceeds to evaluate the rest of the page.
